public_rationale: The ordinary reading is supported. Microsoft's disclosure establishes substantial engagement and useful image-generation applications. October evaluations show major limitations in repository-level software work and current factual answering. Transformer-based robotics demonstrates real breadth, but does not establish all-purpose reliability. This finding does not endorse the separate surrounding assertion about how little transformers were used across AI fields.
limitations: The result depends on interpreting all-purpose as broadly reliable practical competence.
Usage and application examples are company-reported.
Benchmark findings describe particular models and setups; their publication dates identify the contemporary assessments, not exact experimental execution dates.
Search augmentation and human assistance can improve performance.

statement.document_title: Reports of the birth of AGI are greatly exaggerated

from_speaker: nothing like the all purpose tools some people seems to imagine
our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that these technologies were prominent and useful but could not reliably perform the broad range of practical tasks expected of an all-purpose AI system.
I assess the current calendar month through publication, October 1–18, 2023. This is an evaluator-selected reporting window for the ongoing state described.
This does not require proving that transformers were unused in the fields mentioned nearby. Their use in several fields would not itself establish all-purpose reliability.
The reference to what some people imagine is a comparison, not a conditional antecedent.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous records establish substantial attention and practical uses, while evaluations demonstrate major limitations across distinct kinds of tasks.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Contemporaneous evaluations establish broadly reliable performance across the practical tasks at issue, or strong evidence refutes the claimed prominence or meaningful utility.

evidence.explanation: The cumulative usage disclosed on this date demonstrates substantial engagement. The same paragraph documents uses including illustrated stories, social-media thumbnails and design inspiration, supporting practical utility without establishing universal reliability.

evidence.publisher: arXiv; Carlos E. Jimenez and colleagues
evidence.explanation: The October assessment reports severe limitations on real repository issue resolution even when relevant material is supplied. It supports the lack of all-purpose competence, while not measuring the usefulness of assisted coding.

evidence.locator: Section 3.1, LLMs struggle with questions about current information
evidence.explanation: The October assessment identifies a second practical limitation: factual answers requiring current information. These baseline tests exclude browsing; the paper also reports improvements from search augmentation.

The paper reports successful transfer across robots using transformer-based policies. This is material evidence of breadth and qualifies any reading that confines transformers to language, but it does not demonstrate an all-purpose system.
